docs.title: ChuckStation
docs.text: ChuckStation is a series of PlayStation emulators, completely free and open-sourced for the public.

docs.title: Contacting us
docs.text: The project is maintained by Aarvsn you can contact him at aarvsn@disroot.org or join our Discord server

docs.title: Supporting the projects
docs.text: We dont accept donations yet but you can contribute to the project's development to helps us with it.
